name: D04_gold_cavern
motion_prompt: Stationary camera inside an abstract faceted black-and-gold crystalline tunnel. Broad reflected bands of warm light travel gently along the gold planes toward the center and circulate back in a continuous cycle. The rigid geometric facets remain sharp and stable. A subtle slow breathing rotation of the reflected light gives a hypnotic sense of depth without moving the camera. Bold reflective gold, deep black shadows, controlled highlights, continuous shot, no flicker or sudden flashes.
processing: Wan 2.2 first/last frame, 81 frames at 16 fps; crop 2 px top/bottom; optical-flow interpolation to 60 fps; cosine time remap forward then reverse over one 8-second cycle, delivered at 30 fps. Eased reversals avoid a hard cut or a tail-to-head dissolve. ProRes LT master and all-intra H.264 delivery.
